events.body:
## Context

BLT-Action (`blt-action/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-action): it meets 79% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Bronze (the basics: a README, a description, a licence and a logo)

- **Project logo.** Add `logo.svg` (and `logo.png`) to the folder, following the logo guide on design.owaspblt.org.

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **README links the live site.** Put the live site's address near the top of the README (`**Live Site:** https://action.owaspblt.org/`).

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Uses the shared BLT top bar.** Put the shared top bar first in every page (`<blt-nav project="blt-action" ...>` with `https://owaspblt.org/_shared/blt-nav.js`) and use the BLT theme: red-600 primary, neutral grays, light and dark mode, phone-friendly. See design.owaspblt.org and blt-waypoint/public.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Project logo
- [ ] README links the live site
- [ ] Uses the shared BLT top bar
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-action` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-action
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-action
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
